text: Help me lower my [provider, e.g. internet/phone] bill, currently [amount] per month on account [account reference]. Research current competitor offers and prepare a retention-call script with my target price of [amount]. Do not call or submit anything until you've shown me the script and I approve, and pause whenever the provider needs a verification code.
